item.description:
Recognize Natter in every mode

  • Natter now recognizes its own name correctly in every dictation mode, including Raw.

Continue through setup

  • One successfully dictated word now completes the shortcut test.
  • If dictation already works elsewhere, you can continue directly to the optional writing tools.

Reliable speech model setup

  • Interrupted speech model downloads now resume or restart safely instead of leaving setup stuck at “Try the shortcut.”
  • Natter checks that every Core ML model is complete before setup continues.
  • You can return to earlier setup steps, remove an installed model, and see a clear error when a model action fails.

Move the recording overlay

  • Drag the full or compact recording overlay wherever it works best. Natter remembers the position for your next dictation.
  • New setups place the overlay at the bottom-right. Saved positions stay fully visible when your display layout changes.

Keep long dictations awake

  • Natter can now keep your Mac awake from recording start until the transcript is safely delivered. The setting is on by default and still allows the display to sleep.
  • Cut, copy, paste, undo and other standard editing shortcuts now work in the Dictionary, Writing Rules, mode editor and every other editable field.

Sharper dictation, fewer interruptions

  • Raw adds a missing final full stop to ordinary prose while preserving questions, URLs, paths and other technical endings.
  • Dictionary rules and custom words can now be imported and exported.
  • An optional spoken "lowercase" command continues a sentence without forcing an initial capital.
  • Agent correction commands now honour explicit lowercase, uppercase, title case and sentence case instructions, including words spelled letter by letter.
  • Command-Shift-M cycles modes while Tab remains available for terminal completion and other apps.
  • Core services and tests have been split into smaller, focused files with automatic size checks.

Natter throughout

  • The app, executable, Swift modules and developer tools now consistently use the Natter name.
  • Your existing settings, models, history, dictionary and app assignments continue to use the same local data and carry over unchanged.

Reliable delivery in every app

  • Final text is delivered as one normal paste to the app where dictation started, including editors built with Electron.
  • Editors can replace their focused text field without Natter rejecting the transcript, while switching to another app still falls back safely.
  • The trailing space is included in the same paste, extra blank lines are avoided, and the overlay disappears as soon as delivery completes.
  • When an editor does not expose a stable text field, the complete transcript remains on the clipboard as a backup.

More reliable dictation delivery

  • Dictation now lands directly in Conductor's composer instead of falling back to the clipboard.
  • Existing text and the cursor position in Conductor are preserved.
  • Every non-Raw mode now adds missing final punctuation while leaving commands, paths and other technical endings alone.

Modes that fit how you work

  • Choose Fast, Refine or Rewrite processing for each mode. Rename, reorder, duplicate or hide the included modes, and add your own.
  • Raw stays untouched. Every other mode shares faster local cleanup for fillers, repetitions, punctuation and technical terms.
  • Refine uses the optional 4B model for guarded punctuation and flow improvements. Rewrite uses the optional 9B model with instructions you can edit.
  • Say "Enter" or "Send" at the end to submit text when voice submit is enabled. Normal dictation now leaves a trailing space so you can keep talking.
  • Tab switches modes from any app, cancellation is more reliable, and the voice meter keeps its taller centre while each bar moves independently.
  • The overlay now separates final local processing from paced terminal typing, so longer dictations show what Natter is doing.

Faster, more accurate speech

  • New speech engine (Parakeet Unified 0.6B): live preview while you talk, higher-accuracy batch decode when you stop. Roughly a quarter fewer errors overall, 80% fewer on short dictations.
  • Final text lands well under a second after you stop, even for multi-minute dictations.
  • Multi-line text is inserted in one operation instead of line by line.
  • Overlay shows a live word count, and the level meter is now a real frequency spectrum of your voice.
  • Agent mode ends sentences with proper punctuation, and an optional "Tidy false starts" setting removes abandoned thoughts spoken out loud (off by default; words are only ever deleted, never added).
  • The speech model download is now 1.16 GB; Natter asks once and removes the old model automatically.
